# Security & Identity Requirements Quality Checklist: Auth & Character

**Purpose**: Kiểm định chất lượng đặc tả yêu cầu cho hệ thống xác thực cục bộ và quản lý nhân vật (`002-auth-character`).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Security & Authentication Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are password length bounds (`10..128` characters) and local one-way salting/hashing requirements specified without any third-party identity provider? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK002 Are brute-force rate-limit thresholds (`5/min/IP`) and temporary lockout rules (`8 consecutive failures → 15 min`) explicitly quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are refresh-token rotation and token-reuse full-session-revocation behaviors unambiguously specified? [Security, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are ownership enforcement rules and single-active-session replacement semantics clearly specified for both REST and realtime connections? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Character Creation & Progression Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK005 Are character slot limits (`max 4/account`), name uniqueness normalization rules (case-insensitive), and starter hero options (`3 MVP starters`) explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is atomic multi-entity initialization (Character + Starter Inventory + Starter Homestead + Indexes) explicitly required to prevent orphan records? [Recovery, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Are server-side derived stat recalculation and hard-cap enforcement rules consistent with `docs/balancing/combat-formulas.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Are preconditions for switching active heroes (`Safe Zone` + `Out of Combat` + hero owned in `unlockedHeroIds`) unambiguously documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Edge Cases & Auditability

- [ ] CHK009 Are suspended/banned account rejection behaviors and audit logging triggers clearly defined? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the zero-third-party SMTP assumption for account recovery explicitly documented with an operational fallback? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer sign-off confirms requirement quality.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
